user.title: Connect your Snapmaker Artisan
user.description:
Enter the IP address of the printer (Touchscreen: Settings > About). Printers found on your network: {found}

After submitting, go to the printer and tap **Yes** on the connection request shown on the touchscreen.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the printer.

progress.confirm_on_touchscreen: Waiting for you to accept the connection from "Home Assistant" on the touchscreen of the printer at {host}…

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the printer on TCP port 8888. Check the IP address and that the printer is switched on and connected to Wi-Fi.
error.not_confirmed: The connection was not accepted on the touchscreen in time. Try again and tap Yes on the printer.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the log for details.
